summary: NASA's MESSENGER probe sent the first images of Mercury after entering orbit on March 17, transmitted at 0520 EDT (0920 UTC). Launched in 2004, MESSENGER made flybys in 2008 and 2009 before becoming Mercury's first orbiting satellite. NASA will begin MESSENGER's primary mission on April 4 to study Mercury's geology, magnetic and internal composition, and return over 75,000 images.
